# Garzoni

> Garzoni is a personal finance education platform for young adults. It teaches budgeting, saving, investing, debt management, credit scores, and taxes through interactive ten-minute lessons, daily streaks, spaced repetition, and an AI-powered financial coach. Available on web and iOS.

Garzoni is a learning platform — think "Duolingo for personal finance" — not a budgeting tracker. The goal is lasting financial literacy through short, practical, jargon-free lessons. Garzoni is a financial education app, not a registered financial adviser, and does not recommend specific financial products.

## Core Topics
- Budgeting: building a budget, the 50/30/20 rule, tracking spending
- Saving: emergency funds, savings goals, habit formation
- Debt management: avalanche vs snowball payoff strategies
- Investing basics: stocks, bonds, ETFs, compound interest, starting small
- Credit scores: understanding, monitoring, and improving credit
- Taxes: fundamentals explained in plain language
- AI financial coaching: personalised, interactive guidance in simulators

- Lessons are available to read without an account at /learn.
